title: Six Boxes Short
pitch: Victor's radios came out of Ines's chandlery six boxes short. She calls it a storage fee. Get the money for all six.

clue_a.label: Container twenty-two
lines: Six radio boxes, flattened, behind container twenty-two. Ines's shop tape on every one.

clue_b.label: The board at the steps
lines: A chalk board at the water steps for the boatmen. Rope, diesel, and radios. Forty each.
